data.name: HeroIntro
data.value: Pioneer of non-surgical rejuvenation, combining medical precision and the art of natural beauty.

data.name: Narrative1
data.value: r. Kaouthar Kechida is a pillar of aesthetic excellence in Sousse. With a career spanning decades and continents—from the thalassotherapy centers of Tunisia to high-level projects in Saudi Arabia, France (Juan-les-Pins, Cannes), Tunis, Morocco, and Lebanon—she has developed a unique approach that marries strict medical discipline with an artistic eye.

data.name: Narrative2
data.value: Her philosophy differs from the "transformation" trend. Instead, Dr. Kechida believes in restoration. It's about rediscovering the light that time may have dimmed, respecting the unique anatomy of each face, and ensuring that no patient ever leaves with a "done" look—only refreshed.

data.name: Quote
data.value: I do not create beauty; I reveal it. My role is to sweep away the shadows of time so that your true nature can shine.

data.name: ClinicDesc
data.value: Independent clinic specializing in non-surgical facial rejuvenation, volumetry, regenerative stem cell medicine (PRP, nanofat), and anti-aging protocols.
